text: 全国教材工作会议9月8日在京召开。中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席会议并讲话。
text_en: A national textbook work conference was held in Beijing on September 8. Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and delivered a speech.
